payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a storytelling landing page. Use: narrative flow sections, scroll-triggered reveals, chapter-like structure, emotional imagery, brand journey visualization, founder story, mission statement, timeline progression.
payload.best_for: Brand/startup stories, mission-driven products, premium/lifestyle brands, documentary-style products, educational
payload.css_technical_keywords: scroll-snap sections, Intersection Observer for reveals, parallax backgrounds, section transitions, timeline CSS, narrative typography (varied sizes), image-text alternating
payload.do_not_use_for: Technical/complex products (unless narrative-driven), traditional enterprise software
payload.effects_and_animation: Section-to-section animations, scroll-triggered reveals, character/icon animations, morphing transitions, parallax narrative
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Story flows naturally, ☐ Scroll reveals smooth, ☐ Sections timed well, ☐ Emotional hooks present, ☐ Mobile story readable, ☐ Skip option available
payload.keywords: Narrative flow, visual story progression, section transitions, consistent character/brand voice, emotional messaging, journey visualization
payload.primary_colors: Brand primary, warm/emotional colors, varied accent colors per story section, high visual variety
payload.secondary_colors: Story section color coding, emotional state colors (calm, excitement, success), transitional gradients
